name: Creative Studio Project CLI
purpose: Project lifecycle CLI for multi-format creative projects: scaffold from a project template, vendor the studio runtime, generate per-format entry files, validate brief/storyboard/project/composition, plan or run HyperFrames builds per format, approximate captions, and record the creative review.
capabilities: new: scaffold projects/<slug>/ from templates/projects/<id>/ with brief, storyboard, project.json and composition
sync: copy src/studio/ into projects/<slug>/src/_studio/ with a SHA-256 lock (refuses to overwrite local edits)
formats: write src/index.<format>.html entry files for 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 from one index.html
validate: JSON Schema checks, catalogue status of capabilities, reading-time floors, determinism lint, font policy, stale generated files
build: per-format render plan (HyperFrames --composition), audio mux and QA gates; legacy projects delegate to scripts/build-project.sh
captions: approximate cues from measured narration timing (WebVTT + src/captions.js)
review: creative-review rubric with evidence and pass rule

compatibility.notes: new/sync/formats/validate/captions/review/status and build --dry-run verified on Windows (Python 3.14). Real builds need HyperFrames + FFmpeg on the production Mac and have not been run with this tool yet.

security.notes: Writes only inside projects/<slug>/ (and out/ on build). build invokes hyperframes, ffmpeg and the QA script as subprocesses with argument lists (no shell).

approval_evidence: tests/test-studio.py on Windows; build path unverified until a Mac render. Promote after a full build + QA run on the M2 host.
